name: Exa
tagline: Web search built for AI applications.
shortDescription: Search and content retrieval APIs designed for AI research and retrieval workflows.
agentSummary: Useful when agents need semantically relevant web results and page contents without generic scraping setup.
bestFor: Research, web retrieval, content discovery, and RAG pipelines.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Search results still need source evaluation and citation hygiene. Respect robots.txt, site terms, rate limits, copyright, authentication boundaries, and anti-bot controls before asking an agent to crawl or extract content. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging. Store credentials outside source control and use least-privilege scopes, short-lived tokens, or restricted keys where the product supports them.
pricingSummary: Public API pricing with free trial and usage-based tiers.
browserSupport: Dashboard mainly supports API keys and usage.

capabilities.detail: Search, find similar, and content endpoints support agent research.
Usage tiers are visible before integration.
Dashboard mainly supports API keys and usage.
